🚀 cadcraft | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A fast, open-source alternative to AutoCAD for computer-aided design and drafting, accessible across multiple platforms and the web.
✨ Key Features: • AutoCAD-style interface and workflow • Command line interface • Object snaps • Layers • Dimensions
📖 Summary: CADCraft is an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of AutoCAD, built entirely in Rust. It aims to provide a fast and familiar CAD experience with features like command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, and hatches, running on multiple operating systems and the web.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 filmcraft | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A desktop and potentially web-based non-linear video editor for users familiar with Adobe Premiere Pro, offering a high-performance, open-source alternative.
✨ Key Features: • Non-linear video editing • Clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro workflow • Written in pure Rust • Native support for macOS, Windows, and Linux • Browser support via WebAssembly
📖 Summary: FilmCraft is an open-source, non-linear video editor built from scratch in pure Rust, designed as a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro's workflow. It offers native support for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with potential for browser-based use via WebAssembly.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 photocraft | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: A native, high-performance, open-source alternative to professional desktop image editing software like Adobe Photoshop, with a focus on Rust development and PSD compatibility.
✨ Key Features: • Pure Rust implementation • Familiar UI/UX (Photoshop-like) • GPU compositor using wgpu • Copy-on-write tiles and multithreaded filters • Full PSD file support (open, edit, save)
📖 Summary: PhotoCraft is an open-source, native image editing application built entirely in Rust, designed as a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop. It offers a familiar user interface and supports advanced features like layers, masks, adjustment layers, and full PSD file compatibility.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 reddit-tui | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Browsing Reddit content directly from the command line interface.
✨ Key Features: • Subreddit Browsing • Post Viewing • Keyboard Navigation (Vim/Standard) • Configurable (caching, filters) • Support for Redlib backends for enhanced privacy
📖 Summary: Reddit-tui is a lightweight, terminal-based application for browsing Reddit. It allows users to navigate subreddits, view posts and comments, and interact using keyboard shortcuts, all within their command-line interface.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 athena-crisis | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Developing and contributing to the core engine and mechanics of a turn-based tactical strategy game.
✨ Key Features: • Open core technology for game development • Modular package structure (athena, apollo, hera, ui, etc.) • TypeScript and React based • Node.js and pnpm for setup • Documentation and Playground site
📖 Summary: Athena Crisis is an open-core, turn-based tactical strategy game developed using TypeScript and React. The repository provides the core engine and tools for game development, allowing developers to contribute to or build upon the game's mechanics, while the full game content remains proprietary.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
